title: jammy crunchy cozy american dish bake
description: a mediterranean twist on a classic american dish with a crunchy topping and a sweet jammy filling

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: use a fine grind for best results

ingredients.name: double-fry kfc chicken
ingredients.notes: use leftover or store-bought for convenience

ingredients.name: fresh rosemary
ingredients.notes: chopped or whole leaves work well

ingredients.name: shredded cheddar cheese
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds a nice flavor

instructions: preheat a comal or cast-iron skillet to 375	18f (190	18c).
mix together mirin, flour, and a pinch of salt in a large bowl until a dough forms.
knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces depending on desired size.
roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
place a tablespoon of honey in the center of each circle, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
top with a few sprigs of rosemary and a piece of double-fry kfc chicken.
fold the edges of the dough up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
place the sealed dough on the preheated comal or skillet, seam-side down.
bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
while the dish bakes, mix together eggs and a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
after 15 minutes of baking, remove the dish from the oven and brush with the egg mixture.
return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes or until the egg is set and the crust is golden brown.
remove from the oven and top with crushed crackers and shredded cheese if using.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
